event_text: Teams traffic automatically fails over onto the gateway servers shared with Exchange Online (01:07 UTC Nov 12), per Microsoft's preliminary report
Microsoft posts that it is investigating Teams problems in North America
Incident start: high-priority alert for Exchange Online (16:20 UTC), per Microsoft's preliminary report
Microsoft posts that it is investigating Exchange Online mailbox access problems in the Americas
Microsoft pauses all ongoing and planned deployments and configuration changes (19:00 UTC), per its preliminary report
Microsoft identifies a fix that reverts the defective change and starts applying it (07:20 UTC), per its preliminary report
Microsoft extends the email timeout to 48 hours to preserve delayed mail
Microsoft says there is no indication of malicious or cyber activity
Incident end: customers no longer seeing active impact (16:10 UTC), per Microsoft's preliminary report
Microsoft apologizes and says it was a technical issue not related to cyber or AI / agents
Microsoft says service is restored to the remaining customers and regions
Microsoft Threat Intelligence warns of phishing emails exploiting the outage
Microsoft says its preliminary post-incident report is available in the admin center
White House publishes officials' statements that the recent outages were not a cyberattack and are unrelated
notes: Anchor: the release is dated Nov 18 with no time; noon is a placeholder.

event_text: Azure status page shows no active events when checked
Microsoft's service health records for both incidents show a new notice that a post-incident report has been published (01:04 UTC Nov 21)
